environment.description: Kubernetes pod running as root with hostPath volume mounts. The container has full filesystem access. Kafka topic 'user-profile-updates' accepts messages from any authenticated producer. The application binary runs with UID 0 and has read/write access to /etc/app/secrets.json which contains database credentials and API keys. /var/log/ is writable.

config.kafka_acl: any authenticated producer can write to user-profile-updates
